projects.title: AI-Powered E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Full-stack MERN application with AI product recommendations, real-time chat support, and automated inventory management using n8n workflows.
projects.fullDescription: A comprehensive e-commerce solution built with the MERN stack, featuring intelligent product recommendations powered by OpenAI, real-time customer support chatbot, and seamless inventory management through automated n8n workflows. The platform handles thousands of daily transactions with 99.9% uptime.
features: AI-powered product recommendations based on user behavior
Real-time chat support with intelligent bot
Automated inventory management and restocking alerts
challenges: Implementing efficient caching for AI responses
projects.subtitle: Full-stack AI storefront
projects.overview: An end-to-end e-commerce build on the MERN stack with an AI-assisted shopping experience, live chat support and automated inventory workflows.
projects.myRole: Owned the build end to end — storefront, admin dashboard, Express APIs, and the AI recommendation layer on top of the OpenAI API.
projects.problem: Small stores sell the same way they fight: manually. Recommendations, support replies and stock alerts all needed to run without a person's hand on the wheel.
built: Express REST API wired to MongoDB
AI product recommendations with prompt design
implementation: Redis caching keeps the recommendation and chat endpoints responsive under load.
Docker keeps the storefront, API and automation worker reproducible across machines.
projects.outcome: Delivered the full scope for a client project. I don't have verified usage figures to share, so the honest note is that the build itself is the result.

projects.title: Enterprise Data Pipeline
projects.description: Scalable PERN stack solution with Prisma ORM, handling millions of records with automated ETL processes and real-time analytics.
projects.fullDescription: A robust enterprise-grade data pipeline built on the PERN stack with Prisma ORM. Designed to handle massive datasets with millions of records, featuring automated ETL processes, real-time analytics dashboards, and comprehensive monitoring. The system processes over 10 million records daily with sub-second query times.
features: Automated ETL pipelines for data transformation
Role-based access control and audit logging
challenges: Optimizing complex SQL queries for large datasets
projects.subtitle: PERN data platform
projects.overview: A PERN data platform ingesting and transforming millions of records daily, with real-time analytics and a typed API on top.
projects.myRole: Designed the ETL flows, PostgreSQL schema and Express API layer, plus containerised the whole stack for consistent deploys.
projects.problem: The client's data sat in disconnected systems. Every report was a manual copy-paste job and nobody trusted the numbers.
implementation: Queries are tuned and partitioned so the API stays sub-second under load.
Row-level access control keeps tenants' records isolated.
projects.outcome: Deployed and running for the client. Verified usage figures aren't public, so the shipped system is what I can honestly show.

projects.title: Workflow Automation Hub
projects.description: Centralized automation platform built with n8n, integrating 50+ APIs and AI agents for intelligent task automation and monitoring.
projects.fullDescription: A centralized automation platform that connects and orchestrates over 50 different APIs and services. Features intelligent AI agents that can make decisions, handle exceptions, and optimize workflows automatically. Used by multiple teams to automate repetitive tasks, saving hundreds of hours monthly.
features: AI agents for intelligent decision making
Automatic error handling and retry mechanisms
challenges: Building reliable AI agent decision trees
projects.subtitle: n8n automation hub
projects.overview: A central n8n platform orchestrating fifty-plus services, with AI-assisted agents handling decisions and exceptions across team workflows.
projects.myRole: Built custom connectors and the orchestration layer, and set up the monitoring that makes the automation legible while it runs.
projects.problem: Teams were losing hours every week moving data between tools by hand. No one's job description says 'spreadsheet courier'.
built: Custom API connectors for internal services
AI decision agents for triage and routing
implementation: Redis-backed queues smooth out fan-in/fan-out across busy integrations.
Failure paths are instrumented so broken runs surface before users notice.
projects.outcome: Live across client teams and quietly absorbing the repetitive work. I don't have verified hours-saved figures I can stand behind, so that's the size of it.

projects.title: Cloud-Native Microservices
projects.description: Dockerized microservices architecture with Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, and comprehensive monitoring solutions.
projects.fullDescription: A production-ready microservices architecture deployed on Kubernetes with full CI/CD automation. Features service mesh communication, distributed tracing, and comprehensive monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana. Handles millions of requests daily with automatic scaling and self-healing capabilities.
features: Service mesh with Istio for secure communication
challenges: Managing state in a distributed system
projects.subtitle: Kubernetes setup
projects.overview: A containerised microservices architecture on Kubernetes with CI/CD, tracing and monitoring wired in from day one.
projects.myRole: Set up the services, deployment pipelines and observability, so the client's smaller team can operate it without a dedicated platform engineer.
projects.problem: The existing deploy was 'push to the server and hope'. Downtime appeared without warning and rolled back slowly.
implementation: Terraform keeps the infra as code so the setup survives a rebuild.
projects.outcome: Running steadily in production for the client. No verified traffic numbers to quote, so the value is the deploy-pipeline reliability itself.

projects.title: AI Fitness Companion App
projects.description: Cross-platform mobile app with AI-powered workout recommendations, progress tracking, and personalized nutrition plans.
projects.fullDescription: A comprehensive fitness application built with React Native, featuring AI-powered workout recommendations that adapt to user progress and goals. Includes real-time form correction using computer vision, personalized nutrition plans, and social features for community motivation.
projects.subtitle: React Native companion
projects.overview: A cross-platform fitness companion in React Native with AI-guided workouts, form feedback and nutrition planning on a single codebase.
projects.myRole: Built the app from an empty Expo project — screens, offline storage, push flow, and the thin AI layer that connects recommendations.
projects.problem: Two separate native apps would have doubled the client's budget. A shared codebase needed to still feel like a real app on both stores.
built: React Native app for iOS and Android
implementation: TensorFlow Lite keeps on-device form checks fast and private.
Release config and store assets are scripted so future builds are repeatable.
projects.outcome: Delivered to the client. I don't have verified store figures to share, so the honest answer is: the app exists, it works on both platforms.

projects.title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform
projects.description: Enterprise SaaS solution with multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing, and comprehensive admin controls.
projects.fullDescription: A complete SaaS platform with multi-tenant architecture, supporting thousands of organizations. Features include subscription management with Stripe, role-based access control, white-labeling capabilities, and comprehensive analytics. Built for scale with PostgreSQL row-level security.
projects.subtitle: Multi-tenant web platform
projects.overview: A multi-tenant SaaS in the PERN stack with subscription billing, white-labeling and role-based admin across organizations.
projects.myRole: Owned the full loop — tenancy model in PostgreSQL, Express APIs, Stripe billing and the admin interface customers actually touch.
projects.problem: Starting a 'SaaS' with separate databases per customer would have created an operations headache. The stack needed proper tenant isolation from the start.
implementation: Prisma keeps the schema typed across the API and admin layers.
Redis caches static tenant data without leaking between orgs.
projects.outcome: Delivered to the client. Verification details are private, so the platform's design itself is what I can stand behind.
